confirmedFindings.title: Parallel Call Minute Quota Check Race Condition
confirmedFindings.body: Reading tenant balance, awaiting an asynchronous operation, and then writing back the modified balance introduces a classic Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition, enabling attackers to launch hundreds of concurrent calls on depleted balances.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use atomic SQL `UPDATE tenant_balances SET balance = balance - $1 WHERE balance >= $1` or Redis atomic decrement.
